answer: Each identity claims a relic beacon post, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch the keeper files a prism reading. The light must match its spectrum on the public prism table within 3%. A missed epoch dims the beacon 10%; reuse or mismatch burns it. A rented-light ring fails: spectra are key-bound to the relic post, so sharing flags both. 36, then 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest keepers pay 36 once.
